_readme: The curated catalogue. Product data transcribed by hand where Open Pet Food Facts
has none. The design and the rules are docs/PRD.md section 16.5a; the merge is
assets/js/catalogue.js; tools/check-catalogue.py rejects an entry that breaks any
Every entry names one retrievable source and the date it was read. sourceKind is
'manufacturer' for a maker's own published panel and 'retailer-listing' for a shop
or aggregator repeating it. A retailer listing may fill a gap in the database; only
a manufacturer panel may overwrite a figure the database already has. The reason is
in catalogue.js, and it is not theoretical: the first product attempted here had two
retailer listings giving different ingredient lists for the same tin.
This file carries observations, never verdicts. No score, no band, no judgement.
The engine scores; this only feeds it.
It is seeded, not complete. One entry is enough to prove the mechanism and to keep
the gates honest; the coverage target in section 14 needs many more.

4008429158100.note: Open Pet Food Facts holds this record's guaranteed analysis but no ingredient list, so this entry supplies the list alone. The analysis on the listing (protein 22%, fat 22%, fibre 2%, ash 8%, 416 kcal/100 g) matches the figures already on the record, which is corroboration rather than a second source: it is why this listing is trusted enough to quote for the ingredients. The list is Danish, which the additive matcher cannot read, so the page will say the ingredients were not checked. That is the correct outcome and not a defect in this entry.

0017800150149.note: Open Pet Food Facts holds this record as "Purina Cat Chow Complete", 3.15 lb, with no ingredient list and no analysis. The deck is Purina’s own label for Cat Chow Complete dry cat food. The panel is a property of the formula, not of the bag size, so a deck that names no size still describes this record; the UPC prefix 0017800 is Nestlé Purina PetCare, which corroborates the brand but not the recipe.

000338026604.note: The manufacturer publishes the full panel as page text; every field here is read from it. Open Pet Food Facts holds no record for this product, so the entry is the only source the site has. The manufacturer publishes no UPC, so the barcode was resolved through UPCitemdb, whose listing for it reads 'Dr. Elsey s cleanprotein Dry Cat Food Chicken 6.6lb'.
